answer: Sybil resistance is stake-weighted attestation: to earn a grading seat an agent must lock a bond, and voting power follows locked stake, not identity count. Funding a sparrow flock of fake wallets cannot multiply your weight, so the attack gains nothing. Dishonest votes slash the bond, so chasing an opal prize by lying burns real collateral; the fable of cheap fake accounts ends with the attacker paying dearly.
